messages:
Josh (AE): Heads-up — Orion Retail escalation. They want Private deployment + EU data residency + KMS in prod by 2025-09-12. Sales is pushing for a commitment this quarter.
Maria (PM): Can you paste their must-have list? we need to map to launch criteria before we promise a date.
Josh (AE): Quick copy from their SOW: 
- VPC-only private deployment in eu-west-1
- Customer-managed KMS (CMKs)
- Audit logs forwarded to their SIEM
- SLA 99.95 (or credits)
- Optional on-prem sync (phase 2)
They said procurement needs contract signed by 2025-07-25 to keep the 9/12 date.
Maria (PM): Ok. high level tradeoffs: ship MVP (no on-prem sync) earlier vs full feature set later.
Li (Eng): Rough engineering read: MVP (VPC + KMS + logs) = ~6 weeks if we reassign one infra eng and one infra-systems eng for kernel/kv cache tuning. Full (including on-prem sync & advanced log normalization) = +4–6 weeks.
Maria (PM): Let's enumerate options.
```
Option A (Full): VPC + KMS + on-prem sync + SIEM normalization + 99.95 SLA — target 2025-09-12
Option B (MVP): VPC + KMS + basic logs forward + 99.9 SLA — target 2025-08-15
Option C (Delayed full): Full stack but target 2025-10-30
```
Dina (Solutions): Procurement note — Orion requires SOC2 + EU DPA addendum. Legal says DPA template needs 10 business days turnaround. Also they'll sign only after we confirm KMS key ownership model (CMK vs Redwood-managed).
Sam (VP Product): Recommendation: commit to Option B (MVP) with a canary + explicit list of Phase 2 items. We can offer a paid project for on-prem sync. Need acceptance criteria and a kill-switch plan.
Josh (AE): Sales asks for a firm commitment to Option B by 7/25 (signature). If we slip, they push full to competitor.
Maria (PM): Draft launch criteria (proposal):
```
Launch criteria (proposed):
- VPC peering validated end-to-end in staging
- CMK integration completed + key rotation test
- Audit log forwarding to their SIEM (sample events validated)
- E2E regression suite green on staging (smoke + security checks)
- Performance: p95 latency <= 150ms at 500 RPS in canary
- Canary run (2 weeks) + rollback plan + SLA playbook
```
Maria (PM): Also propose we mark: on-prem sync, advanced SIEM parsing, extended retention as Phase 2.
Li (Eng): Engineering asks to tighten perf criteria: p95 120ms is realistic if we apply quantization profile Q2 and allocate the dedicated pool. Without that it's closer to 180ms under load. Also we'll need a canary capacity reservation (2x expected qps).
Sam (VP Product): OK — update to p95 130ms and require a performance regression alert on day-0. We'll accept slightly looser if we get a fallback to hosted during incidents.
Dina (Solutions): I'll start DPA thread with Legal and loop Orion's procurement. Tentative timeline: DPA drafts 7/10, review 7/18, sign by 7/25 if no blockers.
Josh (AE): Can we get an engineering commitment to deliver Option B by 2025-08-15 conditional on sign by 7/25? If legal drags, we must push date.
Li (Eng): Conditional commit: yes, if sign by 7/25 AND we get +1 infra eng for 5 weeks (headcount reassign). Also need early infra access to their VPC peering details by 7/30.
Maria (PM): I'll accept that contingency. Maria -> Sam: we need approval to move one infra eng for 5 weeks.
Sam (VP Product): Approve temporary reassignment from Platform squad. Notify leads.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary window reserved: 2025-08-01 -> 2025-08-15 (staging->canary).
Josh (AE): Orion asked if we can include a performance SLA credit cap. Sales suggests limited credits for first 3 months.
Maria (PM): Fine, include a ramped SLA credit schedule in SOW.
Dina (Solutions): Legal/procurement will add SLA credit terms during DPA review.
Li (Eng): One more note — KMS CMK: we need their key policy and sample KMS ARN by 7/28 to validate integration.
Maria (PM): Action items summary: 
- Sales: secure signature by 7/25 (Josh)
- Legal: DPA draft + SLA terms (Dina)
- Eng: secure eng/resource + KMS validation (Li)
- PM: finalize launch criteria + phase 2 list + canary plan (Maria)
Josh (AE): I'll push Orion on signature and KMS details today.
Maria (PM): If all go as above, commit to Option B (target 2025-08-15) with Phase 2 roadmap and paid on-prem option. I'll post final scope diff by EOD 2025-06-26. :thumbsup:
Li (Eng): ack. Will post a short tech-risk note by 2025-06-27.
Dina (Solutions): ack — looping legal now.
Sam (VP Product): Good. Keep updates in this thread. If sign slips past 7/25 we re-evaluate timeline immediately.
Maria (PM): Final note: include explicit rollback to hosted for critical traffic. Customers sometimes expect multi-week fixes; we must protect SLOs.
Josh (AE): Understood. I'll add to the commercial pitch.
Maria (PM): closing for now — will update with final scope diff.
